_comment: Starter experiment — an EXAMPLE of shape, not a recommendation for your business. Rewriting arms/hypotheses is part of engine-setup. arms.label: claim opener
arms.hypothesis: A flat, specific claim in line one stops the scroll without sounding like bait.

arms.label: question opener
